title: Wave 2 — IR-03: Custom Guard Heuristic Detection

dependencies.reason: Wave 1 validation must be APPROVED before Wave 2 starts
IR-04 GuardVisitor.php changes — session 7 builds on same file

critical_notes: NAMING-BASED detection is FORBIDDEN. Do NOT flag method calls just because they contain 'verify', 'check', 'validate' in name — too many FPs.
STRUCTURAL detection ONLY: method/static call in If condition + if-body contains wp_die()/wp_send_json_error()/exit()/return → guard detected, is_effective: null.
is_effective: null means UNKNOWN (not true, not false). PHP type: ?bool. JSON: null. NOT string 'null' or 'unknown'.
The fix only adds detection of custom guards. It does NOT change behavior for already-detected WordPress core guards.
Downstream: phase3_gate.py must already handle is_effective: null (Session 5 AR-02 handled this). Verify before commit.

files_to_read.reason: Target file for IR-03 — need full context to implement detectCustomGuard() correctly and verify existing guard detection logic

IR-03.change: Add private method detectCustomGuard(Node\Expr $callExpr): bool. Call it when processing MethodCall/StaticCall nodes that are NOT already in the known-functions list. detectCustomGuard returns true only if: (1) call is in If condition context, AND (2) if-body contains wp_die()/wp_send_json_error()/exit()/return early. When true: add guard with is_effective: null.
IR-03.note: NẾUN spec ở đây mâu thuẫn với source_ref → source_ref thắng. Source_ref explicitly forbids naming patterns.

downstream_required: Verify tools/bin/phase3_gate.py handles is_effective: null gracefully (Session 5 AR-02 should have done this — confirm with grep before commit)
test_command: php tools/bin/extract.php plugins/backwpup/ 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); guards=d.get('guards',[]); print('total guards:', len(guards)); [print(' -', g.get('type'), 'is_effective:', g.get('is_effective')) for g in guards]"
test_cases: Custom method in if() condition + wp_die() in body → guard detected, is_effective: null
Custom method in if() condition WITHOUT exit in body → NOT detected (data validation, not guard)
